units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 29:20">Targ. Ex. XXIX, 20</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 137:4">Targ. Ps. CXXXVII, 4</cite> <he>קטעו לואי אִלְיוֹנֵיהוֹן בככיהון</he> (missing in some ed.) the Levites cut their thumbs off with their teeth; v. quot. in <cite ref="A01843">preced.</cite>
